constraints.name: acquisition_deadline_review_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind <> 'deadline_resolution'::text) AND (deadline_term IS NULL) AND (deadline_resolution IS NULL) AND (deadline_original_review_id IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'deadline_resolution'::text) AND (deadline_term IS NOT NULL) AND (deadline_term = ANY (ARRAY['effective'::text, 'inspection_deadline'::text, 'closing_deadline'::text])) AND (((status = 'approved'::text) AND (deadline_original_review_id IS NULL) AND (deadline_resolution IS NOT NULL) AND private.valid_deadline_resolution(deadline_resolution, contract_version) AND ((deadline_resolution ->> 'term'::text) = deadline_term) AND ((((deadline_resolution -> 'source'::text) ->> 'artifact_id'::text))::uuid = artifact_id) AND ((((deadline_resolution -> 'source'::text) ->> 'artifact_version'::text))::integer = source_version) AND (((deadline_resolution -> 'source'::text) ->> 'sha256'::text) = sha256)) OR ((status = 'withdrawn'::text) AND (deadline_resolution IS NULL) AND (deadline_original_review_id IS NOT NULL) AND (deadline_original_review_id <> id) AND (sequence > 1))))))

constraints.name: acquisition_deadline_sources_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'deadline_resolution'::text) AND (status = 'approved'::text) AND (deadline_sources IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(deadline_sources) = 'array'::text) AND ((jsonb_array_length(deadline_sources) >= 1) AND (jsonb_array_length(deadline_sources) <= 2))) OR (((kind <> 'deadline_resolution'::text) OR (status = 'withdrawn'::text)) AND (deadline_sources IS NULL))))

constraints.name: acquisition_disposition_findings_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind <> 'disposition_findings'::text) AND (disposition_findings IS NULL) AND (disposition_sources IS NULL) AND (disposition_plan_id IS NULL) AND (disposition_exit_type IS NULL) AND (disposition_execution_id IS NULL) AND (disposition_title_entry_id IS NULL) AND (disposition_title_review_id IS NULL) AND (disposition_title_status IS NULL) AND (disposition_original_review_id IS NULL) AND (disposition_original_status IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'disposition_findings'::text) AND (purpose = 'purchase_contract'::text) AND (disposition_plan_id IS NOT NULL) AND (disposition_exit_type IS NOT NULL) AND (disposition_exit_type = ANY (ARRAY['principal_acquisition'::text, 'wholesale_assignment'::text])) AND (disposition_execution_id IS NOT NULL) AND (disposition_title_entry_id IS NOT NULL) AND (disposition_title_review_id IS NOT NULL) AND (disposition_title_status IS NOT NULL) AND (disposition_title_status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'requires_resolution'::text])) AND ((status <> 'approved'::text) OR (disposition_title_status = 'approved'::text)) AND (((status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'requires_resolution'::text])) AND (disposition_original_review_id IS NULL) AND (disposition_original_status IS NULL) AND (disposition_findings IS NOT NULL) AND (private.valid_disposition_findings(disposition_findings, contract_version, (status = 'approved'::text), disposition_exit_type) IS TRUE) AND (disposition_sources IS NOT NULL) AND (private.valid_disposition_source_journal(disposition_findings, disposition_sources, contract_version, artifact_id, source_version, verification_id, sha256) IS TRUE)) OR ((status = 'withdrawn'::text) AND (disposition_findings IS NULL) AND (disposition_sources IS NULL) AND (disposition_original_review_id IS NOT NULL) AND (disposition_original_review_id <> id) AND (disposition_original_status IS NOT NULL) AND (disposition_original_status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'requires_resolution'::text])) AND (sequence > 1))))))

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind <> 'executed_contract'::text) AND (execution_findings IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'executed_contract'::text) AND (((status = 'approved'::text) AND (execution_findings IS NOT NULL) AND private.valid_execution_findings(execution_findings, contract_version)) OR ((status = 'withdrawn'::text) AND (execution_findings IS NULL))))))

constraints.name: acquisition_execution_sources_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'executed_contract'::text) AND (status = 'approved'::text) AND (execution_sources IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(execution_sources) = 'array'::text) AND ((jsonb_array_length(execution_sources) >= 1) AND (jsonb_array_length(execution_sources) <= 13))) OR (((kind <> 'executed_contract'::text) OR (status = 'withdrawn'::text)) AND (execution_sources IS NULL))))

constraints.name: acquisition_title_findings_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind <> 'title_findings'::text) AND (title_findings IS NULL) AND (title_sources IS NULL) AND (title_execution_transition_id IS NULL) AND (title_original_review_id IS NULL) AND (title_original_status IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'title_findings'::text) AND (purpose = 'title_report'::text) AND (title_execution_transition_id IS NOT NULL) AND (((status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'requires_resolution'::text])) AND (title_original_review_id IS NULL) AND (title_original_status IS NULL) AND (title_findings IS NOT NULL) AND (private.valid_title_findings(title_findings, contract_version, (status = 'approved'::text)) IS TRUE) AND (title_sources IS NOT NULL) AND (private.valid_title_source_journal(title_findings, title_sources, contract_version, artifact_id, source_version, verification_id, sha256) IS TRUE)) OR ((status = 'withdrawn'::text) AND (title_findings IS NULL) AND (title_sources IS NULL) AND (title_original_review_id IS NOT NULL) AND (title_original_review_id <> id) AND (title_original_status IS NOT NULL) AND (title_original_status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'requires_resolution'::text])) AND (sequence > 1))))))

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((workspace_id IS NULL) AND (acquisition_status IS NULL) AND (acquisition_version IS NULL) AND (acquisition_property_id IS NULL) AND (acquisition_owner_relationship_id IS NULL) AND (acquisition_offer_id IS NULL) AND (acquisition_offer_sequence IS NULL)) OR ((workspace_id IS NOT NULL) AND (acquisition_status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'pending_signature'::text, 'executed'::text, 'title_review'::text])) AND (acquisition_status IS NOT NULL) AND ((acquisition_version >= 1) AND (acquisition_version <= 2147483647)) AND (acquisition_version IS NOT NULL) AND (acquisition_property_id IS NOT NULL) AND (acquisition_owner_relationship_id IS NOT NULL) AND (acquisition_offer_id IS NOT NULL) AND (acquisition_offer_sequence > 0) AND (acquisition_offer_sequence IS NOT NULL) AND (stage = 'offer_made'::text) AND (contract_price IS NULL) AND (buyer_id IS NULL) AND (contract_date IS NULL) AND (closing_date IS NULL) AND (actual_close_date IS NULL) AND (psa_doc_url IS NULL) AND (assignment_doc_url IS NULL))))
